name: Chicken, Kidney Bean & Corn Pilaf
steps: Rinse the rice and cook it in a pot of water on the stove until tender; set aside.
Cut the chicken thighs into bite‑size pieces and brown them in a pan over medium heat.
Add the cooked kidney beans, corn kernels, and the cooked rice to the pan; stir‑fry until heated through.
Push the mixture to the side of the pan, crack the egg into the empty space and scramble it until just set.
Mix the scrambled egg into the rice‑chicken‑bean mixture, heat for another minute, then serve.
image_prompt: golden brown chicken pieces mixed with fluffy white rice, bright yellow corn kernels, reddish kidney beans, and a soft scrambled egg, all steaming together
